name: Project Setup Lifecycle & Operational Roster Architecture Audit

phase1.failureMitigation: On workspace creation failures, projects are written in PENDING_PROVISIONING status, allowing administrative retry.

ratios.globalDriverId: Based on Iqama / National Residency ID (legally binding, system-wide unique key).
ratios.projectRosterId: Project-scoped driver-truck assignment slot identifier, e.g., Q-PRJ-001-DRV-00001.
ratios.tripSnapshot: Immutable copy of driver and truck roster info written directly inside the weighbridge ticket, preserving historic records.

materialAssignment.driverMaterialMultiplicity: A single driver can hold multiple active roster rows or an array of authorized materialIds within their profile.

statusMachine.DRAFT: Editable project details, workspace integrations disabled.
statusMachine.SETUP: Operational roster and pricing rules can be defined.
statusMachine.READY_FOR_REVIEW: Project metadata is locked; pending administrator validation.
statusMachine.APPROVED: Locked, scheduled, waiting for startDate to trigger operation.
statusMachine.ACTIVE: Operations live; weighbridge ticket and dispatching modules unlocked.
